tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Oxbox Energy website: the home page and the Oxbox brochure (specifications, certifications, enclosure and installation details). Ask in plain words, e.g. "Oxbox capacity in kWh" or "Oxbox UL listing". Returns ids, titles and source links; read one with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read the full text of one result from search, find_series or get_documents (a web page, a PDF, or a product series) with its link.

tools.name: find_series
tools.description: Return the Oxbox, the one product Oxbox Energy offers (48 V, VRLA gel tubular plate, for solar and home backup), with its page and brochure.

tools.name: get_documents
tools.description: List the documents Oxbox Energy publishes: the Oxbox brochure, as a digital copy (4 pages) and a printable copy (3 pages) of the same text. The specifications are on the brochure's last page. The website publishes no datasheet, SDS, manual or warranty document.

tools.name: quote_request
tools.description: How to ask Oxbox Energy for a quote or price: the address to write to, and what to include so the engineers can answer without a round of questions. It sends nothing; the customer sends the request themselves.

tools.name: sizing_request
tools.description: Oxbox Energy has no online sizing tool, and this connector cannot size a system. This says how to get one sized: the customer sends the load, runtime and voltage with a quote request and the engineers size it.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sizing_tool" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
